sn22.156:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa Attānudiṭṭhi uppajjatīti || || 4
sn22.156:1.4: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 6-9
sn22.156:1.8: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 10
sn22.156:1.10: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.156:1.13: api nu tam anupādāya attānudiṭṭhi uppajjeyyā ti || ||
sn22.156:1.18: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.156:1.21: api nu tam anupādāya attānudiṭṭhi uppajjeyyāti || ||
